cipher.summary: Deferred circuit-breaker success recording to the caller for 2xx chat responses, capped how long `fetchWithRetry` will honor a server `Retry-After` before giving up, isolated `RateLimitSeam` window state per policy, fixed a shared-reference leak in `RateLimitConfigSeam`'s mock, deduplicated the `meechie-tool` free-text-length constants, and strengthened two test files' "no paid work happened" assertions — closing PR #202's and PR #204's genuinely-still-open review threads.
cipher.risks: No live-traffic validation of the breaker/retry changes (no XAI_API_KEY in this environment); the 30s give-up threshold is a judgment call, not independently tuned; `RateLimitSeam`'s policy-isolation fix has no live caller to exercise it yet; two false-positive findings were left unacknowledged on PR #202's own thread state (scope boundary: new PR, not thread management).
